# ankra_service_credential_grant (Resource)

A purpose-bound reference to a managed-service credential value (`ankra services credentials grants`): it lets one input of one service package digest read the value, in the given mode. It carries no secret. The platform cannot change a grant, so any change replaces it. A grant revoked outside Terraform, or by a rotation of its credential, is planned again. Destroy revokes it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_service_credential_grant" "billing_database" {
  family_id      = ankra_service_credential.billing_database.id
  value_id       = ankra_service_credential.billing_database.active_value_id
  package_digest = "sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  input_name     = "DATABASE_URL"
  mode           = "hosted"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `family_id` (String) Identifier of the credential family (`ankra_service_credential`).
- `input_name` (String) Package input the value is bound to: upper-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
- `mode` (String) `hosted`, `customer` or `existing`.
- `package_digest` (String) Digest of the service package, `sha256:` and 64 hex digits.
- `value_id` (String) Identifier of the credential value granted, normally the family's `active_value_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the grant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by <family_id>/<grant_id>.
terraform import ankra_service_credential_grant.billing_database 5d6e7f80-91a2-4b33-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d/6e7f8091-a2b3-4c44-9d5e-6f7a8b9c0d1e
```
